A '''circuit tester''' was a common tool<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> that could also be incorporated into a [[power calibrator]]. It could be retracted into the tool when not in use.<ref name="EGWT" /> Circuit testers were common components of [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kits]].<ref name="RPG-Core" />
